# Every clause and subclause identifier IEEE 1800-2023 defines, one per line.
#
# This is the set a Subclause("...") string in src/ has to name. What compares
# the two is invalid_citations in scripts/assert_subclause_citations/__init__.py,
# and it exists so that a citation always names something a reader can open.
# It does not judge whether a citation is the right clause for the rule it
# reports, which is a reading of the standard rather than a comparison of
# strings.
#
# The list is committed because ~/LRM.pdf is a local file no CI runner has.
# Regenerate it from the repository root, with the standard at ~/LRM.pdf, by
# running this and putting the header back above the result:
#
#     PYTHONPATH=. python3 - <<'EOF'
#     import os
#     from lib.python.lrm import load_toc
#     for identifier in sorted(load_toc(os.path.expanduser("~/LRM.pdf"))):
#         print(identifier)
#     EOF
#
# load_toc reads the PDF bookmarks and no page content, so regenerating costs
# nothing against the content-filter budget that reading pages spends.
